name: 明黄撞色水润护唇膏款
description: 向日黄撞色底，原料摆拍与膏体微距，配空位主张清单的唇部护理套组

styleLock.backgroundSystem: flat saturated sunflower-yellow #F5C400 graphic field for story, texture and variant screens, seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, cream #F7EEDC panel blocks for info screens, one sunlit outdoor foliage-bokeh exception for the lifestyle screen
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, front-left key with wrap fill, 5200-5600K on graphic screens, low contrast with soft single-direction contact shadows, no harsh speculars, one hard direct-sunlight exception on the outdoor screen
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper sweep and smooth cream laminate panel #F7EEDC, no wood or stone grain, no reflective table mirror
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only, bold uppercase headline plus lighter lowercase sub-line, generous line spacing, left-aligned copy column, all wording supplied as placeholder slots
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs in charcoal #3A2A1E seated in blank rounded chip rows with empty label slots
styleLock.presentationRules: short twist tube kept upright at consistent scale with cap end up and the label face toward the camera, only one new camera angle per screen, no packaging artwork redraw
noDrift: no brand wordmark or source packaging art
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm natural lip-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of saturated sunflower-yellow field #F5C400, cream off-white panel #F7EEDC, charcoal-brown text #3A2A1E and one brick-red accent #C0362C; warm color temperature; flat single-colour graphic background for story screens plus seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, wrap fill and soft single-direction contact shadows, no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif throughout with a bold uppercase headline over a lighter lowercase sub-line; thin single-weight line icons inside blank rounded chip rows; short twist-tube products shown upright and stable at consistent scale with the label face to camera; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 在搜索结果页一眼看清多支组合与开盖露出的膏体，抢首次点击。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, units standing upright in one even row, full height visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with soft fill card, soft contact shadows under each base
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, tight but clean margins around the row
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Several identical units standing upright in one even row, photographed straight-on at eye level with the full height of each unit visible and nothing clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting from a front key with a soft fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows grounding every base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The row of products occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace around it. 8K commercial beauty ecommerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no in-image text, no badge or star rating, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated or fused tube, no floating unit without a contact shadow, no tinted background.

shots.displayName: 挂牌组合装量贩卖点图
shots.intent: 一秒传达可挂陈多支随身的购买理由，承接首图的价值感。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, display carton facing the lens with its rounded hang tab at the top
shots.lighting: soft front-left key with wrap fill, gentle single-direction contact shadow at the carton base
shots.background: flat saturated sunflower-yellow #F5C400 field with a lighter cream #F7EEDC tray panel
shots.whitespace: generous clean space in the upper right corner reserved for one short claim
shots.textZone: upper right corner block for one headline placeholder
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A countertop display carton with a rounded hang-tab header facing the lens, units seated in their slots, photographed straight-on at eye level. Soft front-left key light with wrap fill and a gentle contact shadow at the carton base, over a flat saturated sunflower-yellow #F5C400 field with a lighter cream #F7EEDC tray panel. The carton occupies 50-60% of the frame, leaving generous clean space in the upper right where one blank rounded chip carries only the placeholder headline 「{callout_1}」 in bold uppercase charcoal #3A2A1E at 32pt. Negative: no brand wordmark, no real product packaging artwork, no natural-origin or purity percentage claims, no invented stick counts or net weights, no dense body text, no QR code, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用天然质料道具与左侧留空主张位解释配方逻辑，讲清为什么保湿。
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: soft diffused top light, minimal shadow, one glossy specular read on the syrup pool
shots.props: one rough chunk of textured pale wax, a slow pool of amber syrup #C98A2B, two sprigs of fresh green leaves
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the left third for the copy column
shots.textZone: left third column, three stacked headline-plus-subline blocks
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic flat lay of {product}, one unit lying on a clean diagonal through the middle of the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. Soft diffused top light with minimal shadow and a single glossy specular on the syrup pool. Background smooth cream laminate panel #F7EEDC. Props: one rough chunk of textured pale wax, a slow pool of amber syrup #C98A2B and two sprigs of fresh green leaves, none covering the unit. The product occupies 35-40% of the frame with generous negative space down the left third, where three stacked blocks hold only the placeholders 「{selling_point_1}」, 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in bold uppercase charcoal #3A2A1E over thin grey sub-lines. Negative: no invented ingredient percentages, no natural-origin or purity claims, no source brand wordmark, no certification seal, no dense body copy, no overlapping props hiding the label face, no watermark.

shots.intent: 让买家把自己代入外出随时补涂的真实时刻，建立使用直觉。
shots.camera: tight crop at eye level with a slight off-axis 3/4 turn, candid handheld framing
shots.lighting: hard direct sunlight from the upper right, warm skin highlights, one small specular on the lips
shots.background: sunlit outdoor backdrop with sage-green foliage bokeh #7C8F5B and a pale sky band above
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: a generic adult model applying {product} to the lips. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Tight crop at eye level with a slight off-axis 3/4 turn and a candid handheld feel, the model generic with no recognisable identity, framed from the hairline to the collarbone. Hard direct sunlight from the upper right, warm highlight on the cheekbone, one small specular on the lips, natural shadow under the jaw. Background of sunlit sage-green foliage bokeh #7C8F5B with a pale sky band. The product and the hand holding it occupy 40-50% of the frame with no extra whitespace. Negative: no likeness of the source model or any celebrity, no over-retouched plastic skin, no deformed or extra fingers, no hand covering the product, no readable brand text on the tube, no in-image copy, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用膏体摊涂的厚润纹路做物证，替留空主张位提供可信视觉。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, high 45-degree angle looking down, tight zoom on the smear, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft sweeping side light from the left revealing ridges, one gentle specular, no hard shadow
shots.whitespace: minimal negative space, three small blank label slots around the smear
shots.textZone: top-left, top-right and bottom-centre blank label slots
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the balm texture taken from {product}: a thick smear of pale opaque cream pressed flat so the ridge and drag marks read clearly, tight zoom on that surface. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down with shallow depth of field and the near edge sharp. Soft sweeping side light from the left revealing texture, one gentle specular highlight, no hard shadow. Background flat saturated sunflower-yellow #F5C400. The smear fills 55-60% of the frame; three short blank label slots sit at the top left, top right and bottom centre, each carrying only the placeholders 「{callout_3}」, 「{callout_4}」 and 「{callout_5}」 in bold uppercase charcoal #3A2A1E. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented duration or efficacy wording, no visible brand mark, no plastic-looking texture, no extra props, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用情感认同与干净光泽的唇部状态拉近距离，为收口铺垫。
shots.camera: straight-on head-and-shoulders portrait on the right panel, flat graphic panel straight-on on the left
shots.lighting: soft front key with wrap fill on the face, gentle sheen on bare lips, low contrast
shots.background: split field: cream #F7EEDC copy panel on the left, seamless pure white #FFFFFF behind the model on the right
shots.props: one single unit standing at the foot of the copy panel
shots.whitespace: left panel kept open for a headline block over three blank rule lines
shots.textZone: left panel headline block plus blank body rules
shots.promptTemplate: Split-panel e-commerce screen: {product} shown as one upright unit at the foot of the left panel, beside a straight-on head-and-shoulders portrait of a generic adult with clean glossy bare lips and no recognisable identity. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel flat cream #F7EEDC graphic field, right panel seamless pure white #FFFFFF behind the model. Soft front key light with wrap fill, low contrast, gentle sheen on the lips, soft single-direction shadow. The panel graphic and portrait read as 45-50% of the frame; the left panel carries a headline placeholder 「{callout_6}」 in bold uppercase charcoal #3A2A1E over three blank grey rule lines and generous negative space. Negative: no face of the source model, no manifesto or brand-story copy, no wordmark, no over-smoothed skin without pores, no teeth close-up, no dense body text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 一屏摊开可选色系，让买家自行比较并选规格。
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, units in a loose tumbling scatter
shots.lighting: soft even top light with short shadows all falling in the same direction
shots.whitespace: two clear corner blocks left open at the top right and bottom left
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant screen, {product} repeated as a loose overhead scatter of units with different cap colours, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft even top light with short consistent shadows falling in one direction on a flat saturated sunflower-yellow #F5C400 field. Cap colours hex-pinned as #C0362C, #2E5A8F, #E8A33D, #D2478C, #8CC684, #F0D24A and #A85C9E over identical cream #F7EEDC bodies. The scattered cluster fills 60-70% of the frame, leaving two clean corner blocks at the top right and bottom left for the placeholders 「{callout_7}」 and 「{callout_8}」 in bold uppercase charcoal #3A2A1E. Negative: no flavour or scent names, no invented range count, no mixed lighting between units, no duplicated or fused tube, no brand wordmark, no watermark.

shots.intent: 以四行留空图标位与空白印章框承接主张与凭证，消除下单顾虑。
shots.camera: straight-on flat view of the panel, full height visible, no 3/4 turn
shots.lighting: even high-key flat studio light, no dramatic shadow, faint contact shadow at the panel edge
shots.background: cream #F7EEDC panel card floating on a seamless pure white #FFFFFF field
shots.whitespace: generous even margins around every icon row
shots.textZone: header band plus four stacked blank icon rows and one empty seal frame
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust infographic screen: {product} shown small and upright at the top of a rounded panel card, straight-on flat view with the full panel height visible. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat studio lighting with no dramatic shadow and only a faint contact shadow at the panel edge. Background cream #F7EEDC panel card floating on a seamless pure white #FFFFFF field, header band in brick-red #C0362C. Layout: one header chip holding only the placeholder 「{callout_9}」, then four stacked rows each pairing a thin single-weight line glyph (leaf, droplet, open hand, circular arrow) in charcoal #3A2A1E with a completely blank label slot and a hairline rule, then one empty rounded seal frame with no mark inside. The panel graphic occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous even margins. Negative: no QR code, no URL, no company address or phone line, no invented certification or lab result, no real recycling symbol, no ingredient paragraph, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 8 张源图逐图事实：001 黄底挂牌纸盒组合陈列，右上角有天然来源百分比主张、底部有支数与每支克重数字；002 俯视平铺，一支斜放配蜡块、糖浆与绿叶道具，左栏三组大写主张文案；003 户外硬光下真人手持上唇特写，背景绿植虚化；004 明黄底膏体摊开微距，三处主张标签；005 左文右人分屏，光泽唇部近景肖像加品牌宣言段落与字标；006 俯视散落多支不同色盖，两角主张文字；007 白底并排开盖露膏体正面图；008 包装背板价值清单，四行图标条加成分段落、二维码、网址与厂商法务行。品类判定：产品为无着色、以唇部保湿护理为卖点的管状膏体，属护理而非着色彩妆，故改判「护肤个护／面部护理」，不取源站彩妆唇部类目，leaf 取「管状滋润护唇膏」。已剥离：源品牌名与红色字标、系列名、蜂形图形、黄管装潢与标签排版原样、模特身份与面容、全部原文案原句（含天然来源百分比、保持时长、无添加清单、成分表、回收与环保声明）、支数与克重数字、二维码、网址、厂商与法务信息行、平台徽章与评价字样；相关主张一律改为 {callout_*}／{selling_point_*} 空位与空白图标行、空印章框。
